title: Starter Power and Water
subtitle: Stabilize before expanding
summary: Clean water, basic power, and route prep are the bridge between first-week survival and first-month exploration.
body: Do not leave for a medium-risk route before the first water and power loops are understandable or documented.
Filters, clean water, a charged scanner, and small repair supplies should support the next route rather than bypass it.
If a machine route is missing recipe, model, lang, or no-power status text, record it as a first-month polish issue.
